item.fisherman_house.message_in_a_bottle: If you find this, the cod are biting off the stony point. Tell no one.
Day 40 on the raft. Still no land. Plenty of fish, though.
If found, please return bottle. It was my favourite bottle.
Follow the gulls to the wreck. Mind the drowned.
Our trawler went down with the captain's strongbox. The map is on the back.
To whoever finds this: the lighthouse keeper owes me three emeralds.
Glow bait, rainy night, open water. Trust me.
Message for my brother Wren at the harbour: I'm fine. Keep the pots baited.
The drowned took our nets, but not our chest. It's still down there.
Roses are red, kelp is green, this is the worst poem you've ever seen.
Note to self: crab pots do not work in a puddle.
The swamp folk swear by chum. The ice folk swear at the cold.
